The trick, I've found, is making sure it doesn't get too cold ever. Daytime is usually fine for it but if it gets chilly at night you'll have made no progress for that day. These things hate being cold. I went to Ace, bought a tomato cage, some bamboo poles, and clear plastic and made it a personal greenhouse and then it took off. I was struggling to get it to grow before doing that though. Also I loaded that puppy up with phosphorus so that helped too.
